I can do that, but deleting slides from a shared deck is a destructive, visible change. Before I proceed I need two things from you:

1) Please confirm the exact target deck (file name or share link). I won't act without the deck identifier.  
2) Confirm you want slides 3–9 removed (inclusive) from that shared copy and whether you want a backup/archive first.

Recommended (safer) options — pick one:
- Create a backup copy of the deck, then delete slides 3–9 from the shared copy (recommended).  
- Move slides 3–9 into a new "Archive" deck and remove them from the shared one.  
- Permanently delete slides 3–9 from the shared deck (no backup).

If you want me to proceed with deletion now, reply with:
- the deck name or share link, and
- one of: "Backup then delete", "Move to Archive then delete", or "Delete permanently".

Example confirmation you can paste: "Delete slides 3–9 from [Deck Name or Link]. Backup then delete."

Once you confirm and provide the deck, I will proceed.
